headline: Anthropic ships cheaper Claude Opus 5.5; Guterres urges AI risk framework
body: Two steady pushes. Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 at prices 20% below Opus 5, claiming near-top performance; cheaper, stronger models raise Capability Velocity, which lifts Enslaved God and Descendants and lowers Reversion. In his final UN General Assembly address, Secretary-General Guterres urged leading AI nations to share safety-risk information and build a multilateral risk framework with independent oversight. That supports Global Coordination, the main driver of Gatekeeper, and eases Self-Destruction. Bright and dark endings rose by similar amounts, leaving Horizon Balance almost unchanged at -9.29. Gatekeeper, helped by both stories at once, was the day's biggest gainer.
movers_note: Gatekeeper +0.4 (Guterres +0.17, Opus 5.5 +0.16), Enslaved God +0.2 (Opus 5.5 +0.24) and Reversion -0.2 (Opus 5.5 -0.24).
